325. Range Sum Query

Problem Statement:
Given 2 numbers N and Q followed by N numbers. Now Q inputs of 2 numbers U and V are given. U indicates the starting index and V indicates the ending index. So for each U,V find the sum of all values of the array from the index U to V (1 based indexing).

Input Description:
The input consists of 2 numbers N and Q, followed by N numbers. Then Q inputs of 2 numbers U and V are given. U indicates the starting index and V indicates the ending index. N is up to 100000.
output_spec: For each U,V pair, the output is the sum of all values of the array from index U to V (1-based indexing).
